articles.title: India aims to co-develop, co-design, co-produce, co-manufacture: MEA on Rafale deal with France
articles.summary: India is significantly boosting its 'Make in India' initiative within the defence sector, emphasizing a comprehensive approach that includes co-development, co-design, co-production, and co-manufacturing. This strategy aims to enhance indigenous capabilities and reduce reliance on imports, fostering self-reliance and technological advancement in critical defence technologies, aligning with national security objectives and economic growth.

articles.title: It’s a Most Confusing Time To Be in the US Military
articles.summary: The article highlights a period of significant confusion within the U.S. military, questioning the fundamental purpose of its engagements. It points to a perceived lack of clear principles and strategic clarity among top leadership, suggesting a challenging environment for service members grappling with their mission and the reasons behind their operations. This introspective piece touches upon critical issues of morale and direction.

articles.title: French President Macron hails 'Chandrayaan-3' lunar landing as proof of India's innovation prowess
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron praised India's Chandrayaan-3 mission, highlighting its successful lunar south pole landing as a definitive example of the nation's growing technological capabilities. He lauded India's unique achievement in space exploration, showcasing its significant scientific advancements and global influence in high-tech domains. This international recognition underscores India's prowess in cutting-edge research and development.

articles.title: Neeraj Chopra, Animesh Kujur headline India's athletics squad for 2026 Commonwealth Games
articles.summary: The Athletics Federation of India (AFI) has announced a 32-member Indian athletics team, including 10 women, for the upcoming 2026 Commonwealth Games. This squad is set to compete in Glasgow, with the games scheduled to commence from July 22. The selection highlights India's preparations for major international sporting events.

articles.title: India joins elite group of nations with BMD capability as DRDO conducts 3 missile tests
articles.summary: India successfully conducted the maiden flight-test of the Naval Anti-Ship Missile-Medium Range (NASM-MR). This significant achievement for national defence demonstrated the missile's advanced capabilities, including pinpoint navigation, effective low-level sea-skimming flight, and high terminal accuracy against maritime targets. This marks a crucial step in enhancing the Navy's indigenous strike capabilities and maritime security.
